name: @bojackduy/opencode-fork-lane
description: Fork-lane for OpenCode — lane-inspired copy-on-write git worktrees + session fork. /fork-lane creates a new branch + worktree (reflink for ignored files) and forks the session into it. Agent-callable via fork_lane tool.

scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/tool --external @opencode-ai/sdk --outfile /tmp/fork-lane-server.js && bun build src/tui.tsx --target=bun --external @opencode-ai/plugin/tui --external @opentui/solid --external @opentui/core --external solid-js --outfile /tmp/fork-lane-tui.js
scripts.prepack: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.release:patch: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push --tags
